focus.purpose: The object the pane is about. At most one per pane.

label.purpose: Pane headers, block titles, buttons, nav nodes.

body.purpose: Row titles, form values, prose capped at 72ch.

metadata.purpose: Timestamps, counts, axes, table cells. Tabular figures.

mono.purpose: Values the operator copies verbatim, nothing else.

motion.name: base
motion.purpose: A popover or the palette entering.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent-solid, #006e65); color: var(--text-on-accent, #ffffff); font: 500 12px/1.3 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; height: 24px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-solid-hover, #004f48); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #006e65); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { background: var(--surface-pane, #ffffff); color: var(--text-primary, #1e1f21); font: 500 12px/1.3 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; height: 24px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-default, #7e8085); border-radius: 4px; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #eaebec); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #006e65); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: List Row
components.description: Two-line pane-2 row: title over metadata, tabular figures.
components.html: Warehouse 4, aisle 12412 units · 09:41
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; background: var(--surface-pane, #ffffff); font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--surface-hover, #eaebec); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #006e65); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-row-title { font: 400 12px/1.4 inherit; color: var(--text-primary, #1e1f21); } .ds-row-meta { font: 400 11px/1.35 inherit; color: var(--text-muted, #5c5f64); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Single-line field with the two-tone focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 24px; padding: 0 8px; background: var(--surface-pane, #ffffff); color: var(--text-primary, #1e1f21); font: 400 12px/1.4 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid var(--border-default, #7e8085); border-radius: 4px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted, #5c5f64); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus-ring, #006e65); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Palette Row
components.description: Command palette row with a right-aligned shortcut column; active row on petrol wash.
components.css: .ds-cmd { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; font: 400 12px/1.4 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text-primary, #1e1f21); } .ds-cmd-active { background: var(--accent-subtle, #e7f4f1); } .ds-kbd { font: 400 11px/1.35 inherit; color: var(--text-muted, #5c5f64); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: ShellUX is read, not visited. An operator keeps one window open for a shift and reads it at a glance, repeatedly. The shell hosts plugins in three panes and owns every pixel of chrome. The test for every decision: would an instrument do this?
keyCharacteristics: One sans family (Segoe UI Variable Text), three sizes (11, 12, 13px), three weights (400, 500, 600).
Three surface planes a screenshot can tell apart: content, chrome, frame.
Restrained colour: petrol accent for focus, selection and the primary action only.
Ten interaction states drawn identically on every surface.
Flat. Depth comes from planes and rules; shadows exist only on things that float.
The host speaks for plugins: no machine identifier is ever shown as a heading.

rules.name: The State-Only Rule
rules.body: Colour means state. If a colour is on screen and nothing is focused, selected, primary or past a threshold, remove it.

rules.name: The One Primary Rule
rules.body: At most one petrol-filled control per surface.

rules.name: The Generated-Only Rule
rules.body: No colour is typed by hand anywhere in src/.

rules.name: The Three-Size Rule
rules.body: Type is 11, 12 or 13px. There is no fourth size.

rules.name: The Weight Ladder Rule
rules.body: 400 reads, 500 labels, 600 names the thing in focus.

rules.name: The No-Mono-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for values the operator copies, never for chrome.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow means this is above the panes and will go away.

rules.name: The Instant-Work Rule
rules.body: Nothing the operator does repeatedly waits on an animation.

dos: Do apply the North Star test to every choice: would an instrument do this?
Do keep type at 11, 12 or 13px, and build hierarchy with weight, ink tier and space.
Do use tabular figures on every number.
Do draw focus as the two-tone ring on :focus-visible only, and never remove it.
Do pair every status colour with a word or a mark.
donts: Don't show a publisher's identifier as a heading, and don't show a payload type chip.
Don't build Enterprise Windows: no ribbon, no chrome-heavy toolbars, no grey gradient panels.
Don't build a SaaS dashboard: no card grids, no hero-metric tiles, no warm off-white body.
Don't build a developer tool: no monospace everywhere, no dark because tools are dark.
Don't add consumer polish: no radius above 4px, no illustration, no motion flourishes.
